name: it-reelsmaker-online
description: Optional add-on for IT Reelsmaker: vertical stock footage (Pixabay, Pexels, Magnific), CC-licensed memes (Openverse) and paid AI video generation (Veo, Kling, LTX via fal.ai) for B-roll, plus figure cut-outs on your own server over SSH. Every download and paid run only after you approve the visual plan.

matte_host.title: Server for figure cut-outs (optional)
matte_host.description: SSH host of your own server with rembg, for cut-outs that are too heavy for this computer. Frames of the span are sent only to this host. Leave empty to cut out locally with the core plugin.
